summary: Digital-interaction bizStep vocabulary is OUR draft superset extension of GS1 CBV, never ratified GS1.

declaredDebts.note: All 4 digital bizSteps (Resolving, Requesting, Scanning, Viewing) are draft/provisional Vin superset terms. They mint the gs1.org.ai/cbv/BizStep-<gerund> shape and are openly marked NOT ratified GS1 CBV. Every rendered surface (the .data description and the GS1/cbv/[BizStep].mdx banner) must carry that marking.

Rendering (render View) is EXCLUDED and deferred out of scope: it is a presentation-layer concern, not a business-context state transition. Held here rather than shipped. Revisit only if #105 explicitly rules it in.

ALL 4 digital bizSteps (Resolving, Requesting, Scanning, Viewing) carry EMPTY sameAs — no ref.gs1.org target was fabricated. There is no ratified CBV bizStep for a digital interaction (AIDC capture, record resolve/request/view), and the once-proposed Viewing->BizStep-inspecting projection was DROPPED after review: CBV 'inspecting' is physical-object defect review, not digital record viewing — too loose to assert honestly.

Digital rows use id=BizStep-<gerund> and code=bizstep-<gerund>. This is the #105 canonical URI shape (gs1.org.ai/cbv/BizStep-<gerund>), a DISTINCT namespace from the physical EPCIS/BusinessStep/{code} path. validate.test.ts flags such IDs as warn-only, so the suite stays green.

confirmedAgainst105.note: The gs1.org.ai/cbv/BizStep-<gerund> URI shape and the down-projection convention are CONFIRMED against the real #105 ruling (was taken from the task brief; now verified).
